subject: MAP: POC environment preflight and owners checklist
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Smith <alex.smith@gridlytics.com>, Gridlytics Ops <ops@gridlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: POC environment preflight and owners checklist

Thanks again for the time this morning — good alignment on scope. Per our MAP draft (attached), I pulled together a short preflight checklist for the POC environment and suggested owners so we can hit the target window. Please review and confirm items you own or any blockers.

Quick summary (attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx):
- Target POC readiness date: 2027-05-14 (target close for initial POC run)
- Key infra dependencies:
  * VPC peering / routing between Gridlytics account and Redwood staging (owner: Gridlytics / ops)
  * IP allowlist for outbound Redwood control plane and redirectors (owner: Gridlytics ops / to provide CIDR ranges)
  * SSO / SAML exchange (owner: Gridlytics IAM + Redwood SRE)
  * Secrets management / KMS access (owner: Gridlytics security)

Proposed milestones (high level):
1) Access & routing validated (VPC peering, route tables) — complete by 2027-04-15 — owner: Karthik Iyer (coordinate)
2) SAML metadata exchanged and test user configured — complete by 2027-04-08 — owner: Marissa Cole (coordinate)
3) Allowlist + firewall rules confirmed — complete by 2027-04-06 — owner: Gridlytics ops (please provide ranges)
4) KMS/Key ARNs shared and access validated — complete by 2027-04-22 — owner: Gridlytics security

Action items for Gridlytics ops: please send back the following by 2027-04-06 if possible:
- CIDR/IP ranges for allowlisting (control plane egress + worker IPs)
- AWS account IDs you want to peer with and preferred mechanism (peering vs Transit GW)
- SAML metadata XML (or Okta metadata link) for test SP config
- Any requirement on data residency or restricted subneting we should know about

We attached the working MAP spreadsheet (MAP_v1.xlsx) with a first-pass RACI and timeline. If any of the deadline targets are unrealistic for you, flag them and we’ll re-sync.

Next call: propose short 30m follow-up week of Apr 5 to validate SAML and routing once you have the metadata and CIDRs — I’ll send a Doodle.

Thanks —
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Smith <alex.smith@gridlytics.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Gridlytics Ops <ops@gridlytics.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment preflight and owners checklist

Dylan — thanks for the clear notes. Quick responses inline: 

- We can provide CIDR ranges and the IP allowlist CSV. Ops will validate the outgoing IPs used by Redwood’s control plane and provide a compact list. We expect to have that by 2027-04-05, possibly earlier.
- For SSO: we use Okta (SAML 2.0). I will upload our metadata XML and a link to our Okta admin connector — attaching the metadata file here (saml-metadata.xml).
- KMS: Gridlytics uses AWS KMS; we can share the ARN for a key and a cross-account IAM role if needed. Need to check with security on whether they want the key in our account or allow Redwood to bring its own.
- VPC peering: we prefer Transit Gateway given multiple accounts; we will need Redwood’s VPC IDs and the AWS account ID you want to peer with. If you can confirm the target CIDR for Redwood's worker subnet that will help.

Tentative: timeline looks fine — our internal target to hand off all artifacts is 2027-04-06 to 2027-04-08. If anything slips we’ll flag it.

Attaching: saml-metadata.xml (see attachment)

—Alex
Alex Smith
Head of Infrastructure | Gridlytics
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Smith <alex.smith@gridlytics.com>, Gridlytics Ops <ops@gridlytics.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment preflight and owners checklist

Thanks Alex — and good cadence. I updated the MAP_v1.xlsx with more granular owners and added a checklist tab for the infra handoff (shared link included in related_links). Summary of internal owners for clarity: 

- VPC peering & routing coordination: Karthik Iyer (I will support with runbook and peering template) — target complete 2027-04-15
- SSO/SAML exchange & test account: Marissa Cole — target complete 2027-04-08
- Allowlist ingestion & verification: Alex/ops to provide CSV; Karthik will validate on Redwood side — allowlist confirmed by 2027-04-06
- KMS access/role: Gridlytics security to share ARN; Marissa will validate permissions with your security team — finalize by 2027-04-22

Karthik — I added a short checklist under the "Network" tab in the spreadsheet with the exact artifacts we need (VPC IDs, account IDs, CIDRs, preferred TGW vs peering). Karthik, please take point on scheduling the peering window once Gridlytics confirms the account IDs.

If Gridlytics can provide the allowlist CSV and SAML metadata by 2027-04-06 we’ll be able to meet the 2027-05-14 POC readiness window.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Lead, Enterprise Onboarding | Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Smith <alex.smith@gridlytics.com>, Gridlytics Ops <ops@gridlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment preflight and owners checklist

Thanks Alex — appreciate the quick turnaround and for attaching the SAML metadata. Recap and agreed next steps (so we have a single source of truth):

Agreed owners & dates:
- Allowlist (CIDR/IPs): Gridlytics Ops — deliver by 2027-04-06 (file: gridlytics-allowlist.csv)
- SAML metadata + Okta admin link: Gridlytics IAM — delivered (saml-metadata.xml received) — Marissa will validate and schedule test on 2027-04-07
- VPC peering/Transit GW: Gridlytics Ops + Karthik to coordinate — peering window targeted by 2027-04-15
- KMS/key ARNs: Gridlytics security — provide details by 2027-04-22; Marissa will validate access rights

Immediate asks for Gridlytics ops (by 2027-04-06):
- Attach gridlytics-allowlist.csv with control-plane and worker egress ranges
- Confirm AWS account ID(s) and preferred peering mechanism (TGW vs peering)

We’ll update the MAP_v1.xlsx with these agreed dates and owners and push a final version to the shared Drive link. Once Gridlytics shares the allowlist and KMS info, Karthik will run a short connectivity smoke test and report back.

Proposing a 30-minute touch on 2027-04-07 at 10:00am PT to validate SAML and walk through the allowlist ingestion — I’ll send a calendar invite if that works for everyone.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Dylan Brooks
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
